data_description.dataset_name: SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily 36 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture

spatial_coverage.coverage: The conterminous United States subset of the global 36 km EASE-Grid 2.0 SMAP Level-3 passive-radiometer product.

data_description.data_format: NASA Earthdata / NSIDC HDF5 granules indexed by Common Metadata Repository (CMR)
analytical_capabilities: Analyze daily near-surface soil-moisture states and anomalies
Compare soil-moisture change over weekly to seasonal windows
Track the onset, intensification and recovery of dry or wet conditions
Aggregate retrievals over administrative, climatic or hydrologic regions
Compare satellite soil-moisture trajectories with independent drought indicators

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Volumetric surface soil moisture in cubic metres per cubic metre (m3/m3)
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the SPL3SMP science and quality fields documented for the selected version. Apply retrieval-quality flags before temporal differencing or spatial aggregation, preserve day/night or AM/PM provenance, and do not reinterpret 9 km enhanced, Level-4 root-zone, SMAP-Sentinel or NASA-USDA Palmer-model products as this 36 km Level-3 passive collection.

data_description.data_source: NASA NSIDC DAAC / NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory SMAP mission
